nodes.description: This property specifies the minimal quantity and rounding increment that will be the basis for the billing. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

nodes.label: billingPeriod
nodes.description: The time interval used to compute the invoice.

nodes.label: billingStart
nodes.description: Specifies after how much time this price (or price component) becomes valid and billing starts. Can be used, for example, to model a price increase after the first year of a subscription. The unit of measurement is specified by the unitCode property.

nodes.label: bioChemInteraction
nodes.description: A BioChemEntity that is known to interact with this item.

nodes.label: bioChemSimilarity
nodes.description: A similar BioChemEntity, e.g., obtained by fingerprint similarity algorithms.

nodes.label: biologicalRole
nodes.description: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a biological context.

nodes.label: biomechnicalClass
nodes.description: The biomechanical properties of the bone.

nodes.label: birthDate
nodes.description: Date of birth.

nodes.label: birthPlace
nodes.description: The place where the person was born.

nodes.label: bitrate
nodes.description: The bitrate of the media object.

nodes.label: blogPost
nodes.description: A posting that is part of this blog.

nodes.label: blogPosts
nodes.description: Indicates a post that is part of a [[Blog]]. Note that historically, what we term a "Blog" was once known as a "weblog", and that what we term a "BlogPosting" is now often colloquially referred to as a "blog".

nodes.label: bloodSupply
nodes.description: The blood vessel that carries blood from the heart to the muscle.

nodes.label: boardingGroup
nodes.description: The airline-specific indicator of boarding order / preference.

nodes.label: boardingPolicy
nodes.description: The type of boarding policy used by the airline (e.g. zone-based or group-based).

nodes.label: bodyLocation
nodes.description: Location in the body of the anatomical structure.

nodes.label: bodyType
nodes.description: Indicates the design and body style of the vehicle (e.g. station wagon, hatchback, etc.).

nodes.label: bookEdition
nodes.description: The edition of the book.

nodes.label: bookFormat
nodes.description: The format of the book.

nodes.label: bookingAgent
nodes.description: 'bookingAgent' is an out-dated term indicating a 'broker' that serves as a booking agent.

nodes.label: bookingTime
nodes.description: The date and time the reservation was booked.

nodes.label: borrower
nodes.description: A sub property of participant. The person that borrows the object being lent.

nodes.label: box
nodes.description: A box is the area enclosed by the rectangle formed by two points. The first point is the lower corner, the second point is the upper corner. A box is expressed as two points separated by a space character.

nodes.label: branch
nodes.description: The branches that delineate from the nerve bundle. Not to be confused with [[branchOf]].

nodes.label: branchCode
nodes.description: A short textual code (also called "store code") that uniquely identifies a place of business. The code is typically assigned by the parentOrganization and used in structured URLs.\n\nFor example, in the URL http://www.starbucks.co.uk/store-locator/etc/detail/3047 the code "3047" is a branchCode for a particular branch.

nodes.label: branchOf
nodes.description: The larger organization that this local business is a branch of, if any. Not to be confused with (anatomical) [[branch]].

nodes.label: brand
nodes.description: The brand(s) associated with a product or service, or the brand(s) maintained by an organization or business person.

nodes.label: breadcrumb
nodes.description: A set of links that can help a user understand and navigate a website hierarchy.

nodes.label: breastfeedingWarning
nodes.description: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to this drug's use by breastfeeding mothers.

nodes.label: broadcastAffiliateOf
nodes.description: The media network(s) whose content is broadcast on this station.

nodes.label: broadcastChannelId
nodes.description: The unique address by which the BroadcastService can be identified in a provider lineup. In US, this is typically a number.

nodes.label: broadcastDisplayName
nodes.description: The name displayed in the channel guide. For many US affiliates, it is the network name.

nodes.label: broadcastFrequency
nodes.description: The frequency used for over-the-air broadcasts. Numeric values or simple ranges, e.g. 87-99. In addition a shortcut idiom is supported for frequencies of AM and FM radio channels, e.g. "87 FM".

nodes.label: broadcastFrequencyValue
nodes.description: The frequency in MHz for a particular broadcast.

nodes.label: broadcastOfEvent
nodes.description: The event being broadcast such as a sporting event or awards ceremony.

nodes.label: broadcastServiceTier
nodes.description: The type of service required to have access to the channel (e.g. Standard or Premium).

nodes.label: broadcastSignalModulation
nodes.description: The modulation (e.g. FM, AM, etc) used by a particular broadcast service.

nodes.label: broadcastSubChannel
nodes.description: The subchannel used for the broadcast.

nodes.label: broadcastTimezone
nodes.description: The timezone in [ISO 8601 format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) for which the service bases its broadcasts.

nodes.label: broadcaster
nodes.description: The organization owning or operating the broadcast service.

nodes.label: broker
nodes.description: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller.  In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange.  If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.

nodes.label: browserRequirements
nodes.description: Specifies browser requirements in human-readable text. For example, 'requires HTML5 support'.

nodes.label: busName
nodes.description: The name of the bus (e.g. Bolt Express).

nodes.label: busNumber
nodes.description: The unique identifier for the bus.

nodes.label: businessDays
nodes.description: Days of the week when the merchant typically operates, indicated via opening hours markup.

nodes.label: businessFunction
nodes.description: The business function (e.g. sell, lease, repair, dispose) of the offer or component of a bundle (TypeAndQuantityNode). The default is http://purl.org/goodrelations/v1#Sell.

nodes.label: buyer
nodes.description: A sub property of participant. The participant/person/organization that bought the object.

nodes.label: byArtist
nodes.description: The artist that performed this album or recording.

nodes.label: byDay
nodes.description: Defines the day(s) of the week on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. May be specified using either [[DayOfWeek]], or alternatively [[Text]] conforming to iCal's syntax for byDay recurrence rules.

nodes.label: byMonth
nodes.description: Defines the month(s) of the year on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-12. January is 1.

nodes.label: byMonthDay
nodes.description: Defines the day(s) of the month on which a recurring [[Event]] takes place. Specified as an [[Integer]] between 1-31.

nodes.label: byMonthWeek
nodes.description: Defines the week(s) of the month on which a recurring Event takes place. Specified as an Integer between 1-5. For clarity, byMonthWeek is best used in conjunction with byDay to indicate concepts like the first and third Mondays of a month.

nodes.label: callSign
nodes.description: A [callsign](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Call_sign), as used in broadcasting and radio communications to identify people, radio and TV stations, or vehicles.

nodes.label: calories
nodes.description: The number of calories.

nodes.label: candidate
nodes.description: A sub property of object. The candidate subject of this action.

nodes.label: caption
nodes.description: The caption for this object. For downloadable machine formats (closed caption, subtitles etc.) use MediaObject and indicate the [[encodingFormat]].

nodes.label: carbohydrateContent
nodes.description: The number of grams of carbohydrates.

nodes.label: cargoVolume
nodes.description:
The available volume for cargo or luggage. For automobiles, this is usually the trunk volume.

Typical unit code(s): LTR for liters, FTQ for cubic foot/feet

Note: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

nodes.label: carrier
nodes.description: 'carrier' is an out-dated term indicating the 'provider' for parcel delivery and flights.

nodes.label: carrierRequirements
nodes.description: Specifies specific carrier(s) requirements for the application (e.g. an application may only work on a specific carrier network).

nodes.label: cashBack
nodes.description: A cardholder benefit that pays the cardholder a small percentage of their net expenditures.

nodes.label: catalog
nodes.description: A data catalog which contains this dataset.

nodes.label: catalogNumber
nodes.description: The catalog number for the release.

nodes.label: category
nodes.description: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

nodes.label: cause
nodes.description: The cause of a medical condition.

nodes.label: causeOf
nodes.description: The condition, complication, symptom, sign, etc. caused.

nodes.label: ccRecipient
nodes.description: A sub property of recipient. The recipient copied on a message.

nodes.label: certificationIdentification
nodes.description: Identifier of a certification instance (as registered with an independent certification body). Typically this identifier can be used to consult and verify the certification instance. See also [gs1:certificationIdentification](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationIdentification).

nodes.label: certificationRating
nodes.description: Rating of a certification instance (as defined by an independent certification body). Typically this rating can be used to rate the level to which the requirements of the certification instance are fulfilled. See also [gs1:certificationValue](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationValue).

nodes.label: certificationStatus
nodes.description: Indicates the current status of a certification: active or inactive. See also  [gs1:certificationStatus](https://www.gs1.org/voc/certificationStatus).

nodes.label: character
nodes.description: Fictional person connected with a creative work.

nodes.label: characterAttribute
nodes.description: A piece of data that represents a particular aspect of a fictional character (skill, power, character points, advantage, disadvantage).

nodes.label: characterName
nodes.description: The name of a character played in some acting or performing role, i.e. in a PerformanceRole.

nodes.label: cheatCode
nodes.description: Cheat codes to the game.

nodes.label: checkinTime
nodes.description: The earliest someone may check into a lodging establishment.

nodes.label: checkoutPageURLTemplate
nodes.description: A URL template (RFC 6570) for a checkout page for an offer. This approach allows merchants to specify a URL for online checkout of the offered product, by interpolating parameters such as the logged in user ID, product ID, quantity, discount code etc. Parameter naming and standardization are not specified here.

nodes.label: checkoutTime
nodes.description: The latest someone may check out of a lodging establishment.

nodes.label: chemicalComposition
nodes.description: The chemical composition describes the identity and relative ratio of the chemical elements that make up the substance.

nodes.label: chemicalRole
nodes.description: A role played by the BioChemEntity within a chemical context.

nodes.label: childMaxAge
nodes.description: Maximal age of the child.

nodes.label: childMinAge
nodes.description: Minimal age of the child.

nodes.label: childTaxon
nodes.description: Closest child taxa of the taxon in question.

nodes.label: children
nodes.description: A child of the person.

nodes.label: cholesterolContent
nodes.description: The number of milligrams of cholesterol.

nodes.label: circle
nodes.description: A circle is the circular region of a specified radius centered at a specified latitude and longitude. A circle is expressed as a pair followed by a radius in meters.

nodes.label: citation
nodes.description: A citation or reference to another creative work, such as another publication, web page, scholarly article, etc.

nodes.label: claimInterpreter
nodes.description: For a [[Claim]] interpreted from [[MediaObject]] content, the [[interpretedAsClaim]] property can be used to indicate a claim contained, implied or refined from the content of a [[MediaObject]].

nodes.label: claimReviewed
nodes.description: A short summary of the specific claims reviewed in a ClaimReview.

nodes.label: clincalPharmacology
nodes.description: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).

nodes.label: clinicalPharmacology
nodes.description: Description of the absorption and elimination of drugs, including their concentration (pharmacokinetics, pK) and biological effects (pharmacodynamics, pD).

nodes.label: clipNumber
nodes.description: Position of the clip within an ordered group of clips.

nodes.label: closes
nodes.description: The closing hour of the place or service on the given day(s) of the week.

nodes.label: coach
nodes.description: A person that acts in a coaching role for a sports team.

nodes.label: code
nodes.description: A medical code for the entity, taken from a controlled vocabulary or ontology such as ICD-9, DiseasesDB, MeSH, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, etc.

nodes.label: codeRepository
nodes.description: Link to the repository where the un-compiled, human readable code and related code is located (SVN, GitHub, CodePlex).

nodes.label: codeSampleType
nodes.description: What type of code sample: full (compile ready) solution, code snippet, inline code, scripts, template.

nodes.label: codeValue
nodes.description: A short textual code that uniquely identifies the value.

nodes.label: codingSystem
nodes.description: The coding system, e.g. 'ICD-10'.

nodes.label: colleague
nodes.description: A colleague of the person.

nodes.label: colleagues
nodes.description: A colleague of the person.

nodes.label: collection
nodes.description: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

nodes.label: collectionSize
nodes.description: The number of items in the [[Collection]].

nodes.label: color
nodes.description: The color of the product.

nodes.label: colorSwatch
nodes.description: A color swatch image, visualizing the color of a [[Product]]. Should match the textual description specified in the [[color]] property. This can be a URL or a fully described ImageObject.

nodes.label: colorist
nodes.description: The individual who adds color to inked drawings.

nodes.label: comment
nodes.description: Comments, typically from users.

nodes.label: commentCount
nodes.description: The number of comments this CreativeWork (e.g. Article, Question or Answer) has received. This is most applicable to works published in Web sites with commenting system; additional comments may exist elsewhere.

nodes.label: commentText
nodes.description: The text of the UserComment.

nodes.label: commentTime
nodes.description: The time at which the UserComment was made.

nodes.label: companyRegistration
nodes.description: The official registration information of a business including the organization that issued it such as Company House or Chamber of Commerce in form of a Certification.

nodes.label: competencyRequired
nodes.description: Knowledge, skill, ability or personal attribute that must be demonstrated by a person or other entity in order to do something such as earn an Educational Occupational Credential or understand a LearningResource.

nodes.label: competitor
nodes.description: A competitor in a sports event.

nodes.label: composer
nodes.description: The person or organization who wrote a composition, or who is the composer of a work performed at some event.

nodes.label: comprisedOf
nodes.description: Specifying something physically contained by something else. Typically used here for the underlying anatomical structures, such as organs, that comprise the anatomical system.

nodes.label: conditionsOfAccess
nodes.description: Conditions that affect the availability of, or method(s) of access to, an item. Typically used for real world items such as an [[ArchiveComponent]] held by an [[ArchiveOrganization]]. This property is not suitable for use as a general Web access control mechanism. It is expressed only in natural language.\n\nFor example "Available by appointment from the Reading Room" or "Accessible only from logged-in accounts ".

nodes.label: confirmationNumber
nodes.description: A number that confirms the given order or payment has been received.

nodes.label: connectedTo
nodes.description: Other anatomical structures to which this structure is connected.

nodes.label: constraintProperty
nodes.description: Indicates a property used as a constraint. For example, in the definition of a [[StatisticalVariable]]. The value is a property, either from within Schema.org or from other compatible (e.g. RDF) systems such as DataCommons.org or Wikidata.org.

nodes.label: consumerNotice
nodes.description: A consumer notice, such as a safety warning or mandatory information, related to the product.

nodes.label: contactOption
nodes.description: An option available on this contact point (e.g. a toll-free number or support for hearing-impaired callers).

nodes.label: contactPoint
nodes.description: A contact point for a person or organization.

nodes.label: contactPoints
nodes.description: A contact point for a person or organization.

nodes.label: contactType
nodes.description: A person or organization can have different contact points, for different purposes. For example, a sales contact point, a PR contact point and so on. This property is used to specify the kind of contact point.

nodes.label: contactlessPayment
nodes.description: A secure method for consumers to purchase products or services via debit, credit or smartcards by using RFID or NFC technology.

nodes.label: containedIn
nodes.description: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

nodes.label: containedInPlace
nodes.description: The basic containment relation between a place and one that contains it.

nodes.label: containsPlace
nodes.description: The basic containment relation between a place and another that it contains.

nodes.label: containsSeason
nodes.description: A season that is part of the media series.

nodes.label: contentLocation
nodes.description: The location depicted or described in the content. For example, the location in a photograph or painting.

nodes.label: contentRating
nodes.description: Official rating of a piece of content—for example, 'MPAA PG-13'.

nodes.label: contentReferenceTime
nodes.description: The specific time described by a creative work, for works (e.g. articles, video objects etc.) that emphasise a particular moment within an Event.

nodes.label: contentSize
nodes.description: File size in (mega/kilo)bytes.

nodes.label: contentType
nodes.description: The supported content type(s) for an EntryPoint response.

nodes.label: contentUrl
nodes.description: Actual bytes of the media object, for example the image file or video file.

nodes.label: contraindication
nodes.description: A contraindication for this therapy.

nodes.label: contributor
nodes.description: A secondary contributor to the CreativeWork or Event.

nodes.label: cookTime
nodes.description: The time it takes to actually cook the dish, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

nodes.label: cookingMethod
nodes.description: The method of cooking, such as Frying, Steaming, ...

nodes.label: copyrightHolder
nodes.description: The party holding the legal copyright to the CreativeWork.

nodes.label: copyrightNotice
nodes.description: Text of a notice appropriate for describing the copyright aspects of this Creative Work, ideally indicating the owner of the copyright for the Work.

nodes.label: copyrightYear
nodes.description: The year during which the claimed copyright for the CreativeWork was first asserted.

nodes.label: correction
nodes.description: Indicates a correction to a [[CreativeWork]], either via a [[CorrectionComment]], textually or in another document.

nodes.label: correctionsPolicy
nodes.description: For an [[Organization]] (e.g. [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement describing (in news media, the newsroom’s) disclosure and correction policy for errors.

nodes.label: costCategory
nodes.description: The category of cost, such as wholesale, retail, reimbursement cap, etc.

nodes.label: costCurrency
nodes.description: The currency (in 3-letter) of the drug cost. See: http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217.

nodes.label: costOrigin
nodes.description: Additional details to capture the origin of the cost data. For example, 'Medicare Part B'.

nodes.label: costPerUnit
nodes.description: The cost per unit of the drug.

nodes.label: countriesNotSupported
nodes.description: Countries for which the application is not supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

nodes.label: countriesSupported
nodes.description: Countries for which the application is supported. You can also provide the two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

nodes.label: countryOfAssembly
nodes.description: The place where the product was assembled.

nodes.label: countryOfLastProcessing
nodes.description: The place where the item (typically [[Product]]) was last processed and tested before importation.

nodes.label: countryOfOrigin
nodes.description:
The country of origin of something, including products as well as creative  works such as movie and TV content.

In the case of TV and movie, this would be the country of the principle offices of the production company or individual responsible for the movie. For other kinds of [[CreativeWork]] it is difficult to provide fully general guidance, and properties such as [[contentLocation]] and [[locationCreated]] may be more applicable.

In the case of products, the country of origin of the product. The exact interpretation of this may vary by context and product type, and cannot be fully enumerated here.

nodes.label: course
nodes.description: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

nodes.label: courseCode
nodes.description: The identifier for the [[Course]] used by the course [[provider]] (e.g. CS101 or 6.001).

nodes.label: courseMode
nodes.description: The medium or means of delivery of the course instance or the mode of study, either as a text label (e.g. "online", "onsite" or "blended"; "synchronous" or "asynchronous"; "full-time" or "part-time") or as a URL reference to a term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. https://ceds.ed.gov/element/001311#Asynchronous).

nodes.label: coursePrerequisites
nodes.description: Requirements for taking the Course. May be completion of another [[Course]] or a textual description like "permission of instructor". Requirements may be a pre-requisite competency, referenced using [[AlignmentObject]].

nodes.label: courseSchedule
nodes.description: Represents the length and pace of a course, expressed as a [[Schedule]].

nodes.label: courseWorkload
nodes.description: The amount of work expected of students taking the course, often provided as a figure per week or per month, and may be broken down by type. For example, "2 hours of lectures, 1 hour of lab work and 3 hours of independent study per week".

nodes.label: coverageEndTime
nodes.description: The time when the live blog will stop covering the Event. Note that coverage may continue after the Event concludes.

nodes.label: coverageStartTime
nodes.description: The time when the live blog will begin covering the Event. Note that coverage may begin before the Event's start time. The LiveBlogPosting may also be created before coverage begins.

nodes.label: creativeWorkStatus
nodes.description: The status of a creative work in terms of its stage in a lifecycle. Example terms include Incomplete, Draft, Published, Obsolete. Some organizations define a set of terms for the stages of their publication lifecycle.

nodes.label: creator
nodes.description: The creator/author of this CreativeWork. This is the same as the Author property for CreativeWork.

nodes.label: credentialCategory
nodes.description: The category or type of credential being described, for example "degree”, “certificate”, “badge”, or more specific term.

nodes.label: creditText
nodes.description: Text that can be used to credit person(s) and/or organization(s) associated with a published Creative Work.

nodes.label: creditedTo
nodes.description: The group the release is credited to if different than the byArtist. For example, Red and Blue is credited to "Stefani Germanotta Band", but by Lady Gaga.

nodes.label: cssSelector
nodes.description: A CSS selector, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

nodes.label: currenciesAccepted
nodes.description: The currency accepted.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

nodes.label: currency
nodes.description: The currency in which the monetary amount is expressed.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

nodes.label: currentExchangeRate
nodes.description: The current price of a currency.

nodes.label: customer
nodes.description: Party placing the order or paying the invoice.

nodes.label: customerRemorseReturnFees
nodes.description: The type of return fees if the product is returned due to customer remorse.

nodes.label: customerRemorseReturnLabelSource
nodes.description: The method (from an enumeration) by which the customer obtains a return shipping label for a product returned due to customer remorse.

nodes.label: customerRemorseReturnShippingFeesAmount
nodes.description: The amount of shipping costs if a product is returned due to customer remorse. Applicable when property [[customerRemorseReturnFees]] equals [[ReturnShippingFees]].

nodes.label: cutoffTime
nodes.description: Order cutoff time allows merchants to describe the time after which they will no longer process orders received on that day. For orders processed after cutoff time, one day gets added to the delivery time estimate. This property is expected to be most typically used via the [[ShippingRateSettings]] publication pattern. The time is indicated using the ISO-8601 Time format, e.g. "23:30:00-05:00" would represent 6:30 pm Eastern Standard Time (EST) which is 5 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

nodes.label: cvdCollectionDate
nodes.description: collectiondate - Date for which patient counts are reported.

nodes.label: cvdFacilityCounty
nodes.description: Name of the County of the NHSN facility that this data record applies to. Use [[cvdFacilityId]] to identify the facility. To provide other details, [[healthcareReportingData]] can be used on a [[Hospital]] entry.

nodes.label: cvdFacilityId
nodes.description: Identifier of the NHSN facility that this data record applies to. Use [[cvdFacilityCounty]] to indicate the county. To provide other details, [[healthcareReportingData]] can be used on a [[Hospital]] entry.

nodes.label: cvdNumBeds
nodes.description: numbeds - HOSPITAL INPATIENT BEDS: Inpatient beds, including all staffed, licensed, and overflow (surge) beds used for inpatients.

nodes.label: cvdNumBedsOcc
nodes.description: numbedsocc - HOSPITAL INPATIENT BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient beds that are occupied.

nodes.label: cvdNumC19Died
nodes.description: numc19died - DEATHS: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who died in the hospital, ED, or any overflow location.

nodes.label: cvdNumC19HOPats
nodes.description: numc19hopats - HOSPITAL ONSET: Patients hospitalized in an NHSN inpatient care location with onset of suspected or confirmed COVID-19 14 or more days after hospitalization.

nodes.label: cvdNumC19HospPats
nodes.description: numc19hosppats - HOSPITALIZED: Patients currently hospitalized in an inpatient care location who have suspected or confirmed COVID-19.

nodes.label: cvdNumC19MechVentPats
nodes.description: numc19mechventpats - HOSPITALIZED and VENTILATED: Patients hospitalized in an NHSN inpatient care location who have suspected or confirmed COVID-19 and are on a mechanical ventilator.

nodes.label: cvdNumC19OFMechVentPats
nodes.description: numc19ofmechventpats - ED/OVERFLOW and VENTILATED: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed and on a mechanical ventilator.

nodes.label: cvdNumC19OverflowPats
nodes.description: numc19overflowpats - ED/OVERFLOW: Patients with suspected or confirmed COVID-19 who are in the ED or any overflow location awaiting an inpatient bed.

nodes.label: cvdNumICUBeds
nodes.description: numicubeds - ICU BEDS: Total number of staffed inpatient intensive care unit (ICU) beds.

nodes.label: cvdNumICUBedsOcc
nodes.description: numicubedsocc - ICU BED OCCUPANCY: Total number of staffed inpatient ICU beds that are occupied.

nodes.label: cvdNumTotBeds
nodes.description: numtotbeds - ALL HOSPITAL BEDS: Total number of all inpatient and outpatient beds, including all staffed, ICU, licensed, and overflow (surge) beds used for inpatients or outpatients.

nodes.label: cvdNumVent
nodes.description: numvent - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS: Total number of ventilators available.

nodes.label: cvdNumVentUse
nodes.description: numventuse - MECHANICAL VENTILATORS IN USE: Total number of ventilators in use.

nodes.label: data
nodes.description: Data associated with the event, like for instance a log message.

nodes.label: dataFeedElement
nodes.description: An item within a data feed. Data feeds may have many elements.

nodes.label: dataset
nodes.description: A dataset contained in this catalog.

nodes.label: datasetTimeInterval
nodes.description: The range of temporal applicability of a dataset, e.g. for a 2011 census dataset, the year 2011 (in ISO 8601 time interval format).

nodes.label: dateCreated
nodes.description: The date on which the CreativeWork was created or the item was added to a DataFeed.

nodes.label: dateDeleted
nodes.description: The datetime the item was removed from the DataFeed.

nodes.label: dateIssued
nodes.description: The date the ticket was issued.

nodes.label: dateModified
nodes.description: The date on which the CreativeWork was most recently modified or when the item's entry was modified within a DataFeed.

nodes.label: datePosted
nodes.description: Publication date of an online listing.

nodes.label: datePublished
nodes.description: Date of first publication or broadcast. For example the date a [[CreativeWork]] was broadcast or a [[Certification]] was issued.

nodes.label: dateRead
nodes.description: The date/time at which the message has been read by the recipient if a single recipient exists.

nodes.label: dateReceived
nodes.description: The date/time the message was received if a single recipient exists.

nodes.label: dateSent
nodes.description: The date/time at which the message was sent.

nodes.label: dateVehicleFirstRegistered
nodes.description: The date of the first registration of the vehicle with the respective public authorities.

nodes.label: dateline
nodes.description:
A [dateline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dateline) is a brief piece of text included in news articles that describes where and when the story was written or filed though the date is often omitted. Sometimes only a placename is provided.

Structured representations of dateline-related information can also be expressed more explicitly using [[locationCreated]] (which represents where a work was created, e.g. where a news report was written).  For location depicted or described in the content, use [[contentLocation]].

Dateline summaries are oriented more towards human readers than towards automated processing, and can vary substantially. Some examples: "BEIRUT, Lebanon, June 2.", "Paris, France", "December 19, 2017 11:43AM Reporting from Washington", "Beijing/Moscow", "QUEZON CITY, Philippines".

nodes.label: dayOfWeek
nodes.description: The day of the week for which these opening hours are valid.

nodes.label: deathDate
nodes.description: Date of death.

nodes.label: deathPlace
nodes.description: The place where the person died.

nodes.label: defaultValue
nodes.description: The default value of the input.  For properties that expect a literal, the default is a literal value, for properties that expect an object, it's an ID reference to one of the current values.

nodes.label: deliveryAddress
nodes.description: Destination address.

nodes.label: deliveryLeadTime
nodes.description: The typical delay between the receipt of the order and the goods either leaving the warehouse or being prepared for pickup, in case the delivery method is on site pickup.

nodes.label: deliveryMethod
nodes.description: A sub property of instrument. The method of delivery.

nodes.label: deliveryStatus
nodes.description: New entry added as the package passes through each leg of its journey (from shipment to final delivery).

nodes.label: deliveryTime
nodes.description: The total delay between the receipt of the order and the goods reaching the final customer.

nodes.label: department
nodes.description: A relationship between an organization and a department of that organization, also described as an organization (allowing different urls, logos, opening hours). For example: a store with a pharmacy, or a bakery with a cafe.

nodes.label: departureAirport
nodes.description: The airport where the flight originates.

nodes.label: departureBoatTerminal
nodes.description: The terminal or port from which the boat departs.

nodes.label: departureBusStop
nodes.description: The stop or station from which the bus departs.

nodes.label: departureGate
nodes.description: Identifier of the flight's departure gate.

nodes.label: departurePlatform
nodes.description: The platform from which the train departs.

nodes.label: departureStation
nodes.description: The station from which the train departs.

nodes.label: departureTerminal
nodes.description: Identifier of the flight's departure terminal.

nodes.label: departureTime
nodes.description: The expected departure time.

nodes.label: dependencies
nodes.description: Prerequisites needed to fulfill steps in article.

nodes.label: depth
nodes.description: The depth of the item.

nodes.label: description
nodes.description: A description of the item.

nodes.label: device
nodes.description: Device required to run the application. Used in cases where a specific make/model is required to run the application.

nodes.label: diagnosis
nodes.description: One or more alternative conditions considered in the differential diagnosis process as output of a diagnosis process.

nodes.label: diagram
nodes.description: An image containing a diagram that illustrates the structure and/or its component substructures and/or connections with other structures.

nodes.label: diet
nodes.description: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

nodes.label: dietFeatures
nodes.description: Nutritional information specific to the dietary plan. May include dietary recommendations on what foods to avoid, what foods to consume, and specific alterations/deviations from the USDA or other regulatory body's approved dietary guidelines.

nodes.label: differentialDiagnosis
nodes.description: One of a set of differential diagnoses for the condition. Specifically, a closely-related or competing diagnosis typically considered later in the cognitive process whereby this medical condition is distinguished from others most likely responsible for a similar collection of signs and symptoms to reach the most parsimonious diagnosis or diagnoses in a patient.

nodes.label: digitalSourceType
nodes.description: Indicates an IPTCDigitalSourceEnumeration code indicating the nature of the digital source(s) for some [[CreativeWork]].

nodes.label: directApply
nodes.description: Indicates whether an [[url]] that is associated with a [[JobPosting]] enables direct application for the job, via the posting website. A job posting is considered to have directApply of [[True]] if an application process for the specified job can be directly initiated via the url(s) given (noting that e.g. multiple internet domains might nevertheless be involved at an implementation level). A value of [[False]] is appropriate if there is no clear path to applying directly online for the specified job, navigating directly from the JobPosting url(s) supplied.

nodes.label: director
nodes.description: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video gaming etc. content, or of an event. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

nodes.label: directors
nodes.description: A director of e.g. TV, radio, movie, video games etc. content. Directors can be associated with individual items or with a series, episode, clip.

nodes.label: disambiguatingDescription
nodes.description: A sub property of description. A short description of the item used to disambiguate from other, similar items. Information from other properties (in particular, name) may be necessary for the description to be useful for disambiguation.

nodes.label: discount
nodes.description: Any discount applied (to an Order).

nodes.label: discountCode
nodes.description: Code used to redeem a discount.

nodes.label: discountCurrency
nodes.description: The currency of the discount.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

nodes.label: discusses
nodes.description: Specifies the CreativeWork associated with the UserComment.

nodes.label: discussionUrl
nodes.description: A link to the page containing the comments of the CreativeWork.

nodes.label: diseasePreventionInfo
nodes.description: Information about disease prevention.

nodes.label: diseaseSpreadStatistics
nodes.description:
Statistical information about the spread of a disease, either as [[WebContent]], or
  described directly as a [[Dataset]], or the specific [[Observation]]s in the dataset. When a [[WebContent]] URL is
  provided, the page indicated might also contain more such markup.

nodes.label: displayLocation
nodes.description: The location at which an item can be viewed or experienced in-person.

nodes.label: dissolutionDate
nodes.description: The date that this organization was dissolved.

nodes.label: distance
nodes.description: The distance travelled, e.g. exercising or travelling.

nodes.label: distinguishingSign
nodes.description: One of a set of signs and symptoms that can be used to distinguish this diagnosis from others in the differential diagnosis.

nodes.label: distribution
nodes.description: A downloadable form of this dataset, at a specific location, in a specific format. This property can be repeated if different variations are available. There is no expectation that different downloadable distributions must contain exactly equivalent information (see also [DCAT](https://www.w3.org/TR/vocab-dcat-3/#Class:Distribution) on this point). Different distributions might include or exclude different subsets of the entire dataset, for example.

nodes.label: diversityPolicy
nodes.description: Statement on diversity policy by an [[Organization]] e.g. a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]. For a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], a statement describing the newsroom’s diversity policy on both staffing and sources, typically providing staffing data.

nodes.label: diversityStaffingReport
nodes.description: For an [[Organization]] (often but not necessarily a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a report on staffing diversity issues. In a news context this might be for example ASNE or RTDNA (US) reports, or self-reported.

nodes.label: documentation
nodes.description: Further documentation describing the Web API in more detail.

nodes.label: doesNotShip
nodes.description: Indicates when shipping to a particular [[shippingDestination]] is not available.

nodes.label: domainIncludes
nodes.description: Relates a property to a class that is (one of) the type(s) the property is expected to be used on.

nodes.label: domiciledMortgage
nodes.description: Whether borrower is a resident of the jurisdiction where the property is located.

nodes.label: doorTime
nodes.description: The time admission will commence.

nodes.label: dosageForm
nodes.description: A dosage form in which this drug/supplement is available, e.g. 'tablet', 'suspension', 'injection'.

nodes.label: doseSchedule
nodes.description: A dosing schedule for the drug for a given population, either observed, recommended, or maximum dose based on the type used.

nodes.label: doseUnit
nodes.description: The unit of the dose, e.g. 'mg'.

nodes.label: doseValue
nodes.description: The value of the dose, e.g. 500.

nodes.label: downPayment
nodes.description: a type of payment made in cash during the onset of the purchase of an expensive good/service. The payment typically represents only a percentage of the full purchase price.

nodes.label: downloadUrl
nodes.description: If the file can be downloaded, URL to download the binary.

nodes.label: downvoteCount
nodes.description: The number of downvotes this question, answer or comment has received from the community.

nodes.label: drainsTo
nodes.description: The vasculature that the vein drains into.

nodes.label: driveWheelConfiguration
nodes.description: The drive wheel configuration, i.e. which roadwheels will receive torque from the vehicle's engine via the drivetrain.

nodes.label: dropoffLocation
nodes.description: Where a rental car can be dropped off.

nodes.label: dropoffTime
nodes.description: When a rental car can be dropped off.

nodes.label: drug
nodes.description: Specifying a drug or medicine used in a medication procedure.

nodes.label: drugClass
nodes.description: The class of drug this belongs to (e.g., statins).

nodes.label: drugUnit
nodes.description: The unit in which the drug is measured, e.g. '5 mg tablet'.

nodes.label: duns
nodes.description: The Dun & Bradstreet DUNS number for identifying an organization or business person.

nodes.label: duplicateTherapy
nodes.description: A therapy that duplicates or overlaps this one.

nodes.label: duration
nodes.description: The duration of the item (movie, audio recording, event, etc.) in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

nodes.label: durationOfWarranty
nodes.description: The duration of the warranty promise. Common unitCode values are ANN for year, MON for months, or DAY for days.

nodes.label: duringMedia
nodes.description: A media object representing the circumstances while performing this direction.

nodes.label: earlyPrepaymentPenalty
nodes.description: The amount to be paid as a penalty in the event of early payment of the loan.

nodes.label: editEIDR
nodes.description:
An [EIDR](https://eidr.org/) (Entertainment Identifier Registry) [[identifier]] representing a specific edit / edition for a work of film or television.

For example, the motion picture known as "Ghostbusters" whose [[titleEIDR]] is "10.5240/7EC7-228A-510A-053E-CBB8-J" has several edits, e.g. "10.5240/1F2A-E1C5-680A-14C6-E76B-I" and "10.5240/8A35-3BEE-6497-5D12-9E4F-3".

Since schema.org types like [[Movie]] and [[TVEpisode]] can be used for both works and their multiple expressions, it is possible to use [[titleEIDR]] alone (for a general description), or alongside [[editEIDR]] for a more edit-specific description.

nodes.label: editor
nodes.description: Specifies the Person who edited the CreativeWork.

nodes.label: eduQuestionType
nodes.description: For questions that are part of learning resources (e.g. Quiz), eduQuestionType indicates the format of question being given. Example: "Multiple choice", "Open ended", "Flashcard".

nodes.label: educationRequirements
nodes.description: Educational background needed for the position or Occupation.

nodes.label: educationalAlignment
nodes.description:
An alignment to an established educational framework.

This property should not be used where the nature of the alignment can be described using a simple property, for example to express that a resource [[teaches]] or [[assesses]] a competency.

nodes.label: educationalCredentialAwarded
nodes.description: A description of the qualification, award, certificate, diploma or other educational credential awarded as a consequence of successful completion of this course or program.

nodes.label: educationalFramework
nodes.description: The framework to which the resource being described is aligned.

nodes.label: educationalLevel
nodes.description: The level in terms of progression through an educational or training context. Examples of educational levels include 'beginner', 'intermediate' or 'advanced', and formal sets of level indicators.

nodes.label: educationalProgramMode
nodes.description: Similar to courseMode, the medium or means of delivery of the program as a whole. The value may either be a text label (e.g. "online", "onsite" or "blended"; "synchronous" or "asynchronous"; "full-time" or "part-time") or a URL reference to a term from a controlled vocabulary (e.g. https://ceds.ed.gov/element/001311#Asynchronous ).

nodes.label: educationalRole
nodes.description: An educationalRole of an EducationalAudience.

nodes.label: educationalUse
nodes.description: The purpose of a work in the context of education; for example, 'assignment', 'group work'.

nodes.label: elevation
nodes.description: The elevation of a location ([WGS 84](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/World_Geodetic_System)). Values may be of the form 'NUMBER UNIT\_OF\_MEASUREMENT' (e.g., '1,000 m', '3,200 ft') while numbers alone should be assumed to be a value in meters.

nodes.label: eligibilityToWorkRequirement
nodes.description: The legal requirements such as citizenship, visa and other documentation required for an applicant to this job.

nodes.label: eligibleCustomerType
nodes.description: The type(s) of customers for which the given offer is valid.

nodes.label: eligibleDuration
nodes.description: The duration for which the given offer is valid.

nodes.label: eligibleQuantity
nodes.description: The interval and unit of measurement of ordering quantities for which the offer or price specification is valid. This allows e.g. specifying that a certain freight charge is valid only for a certain quantity.

nodes.label: eligibleRegion
nodes.description: The ISO 3166-1 (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) or ISO 3166-2 code, the place, or the GeoShape for the geo-political region(s) for which the offer or delivery charge specification is valid.\n\nSee also [[ineligibleRegion]].

nodes.label: eligibleTransactionVolume
nodes.description: The transaction volume, in a monetary unit, for which the offer or price specification is valid, e.g. for indicating a minimal purchasing volume, to express free shipping above a certain order volume, or to limit the acceptance of credit cards to purchases to a certain minimal amount.

nodes.label: eligibleWithSupplier
nodes.description: The supplier of the incentivized item/service for which the incentive is valid for such as a utility company, merchant, or contractor.

nodes.label: email
nodes.description: Email address.

nodes.label: embedUrl
nodes.description: A URL pointing to a player for a specific video. In general, this is the information in the ```src``` element of an ```embed``` tag and should not be the same as the content of the ```loc``` tag.

nodes.label: embeddedTextCaption
nodes.description: Represents textual captioning from a [[MediaObject]], e.g. text of a 'meme'.

nodes.label: emissionsCO2
nodes.description: The CO2 emissions in g/km. When used in combination with a QuantitativeValue, put "g/km" into the unitText property of that value, since there is no UN/CEFACT Common Code for "g/km".

nodes.label: employee
nodes.description: Someone working for this organization.

nodes.label: employees
nodes.description: People working for this organization.

nodes.label: employerOverview
nodes.description: A description of the employer, career opportunities and work environment for this position.

nodes.label: employmentType
nodes.description: Type of employment (e.g. full-time, part-time, contract, temporary, seasonal, internship).

nodes.label: employmentUnit
nodes.description: Indicates the department, unit and/or facility where the employee reports and/or in which the job is to be performed.

nodes.label: encodesBioChemEntity
nodes.description: Another BioChemEntity encoded by this one.

nodes.label: encodesCreativeWork
nodes.description: The CreativeWork encoded by this media object.

nodes.label: encoding
nodes.description: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork. This property is a synonym for associatedMedia.

nodes.label: encodingFormat
nodes.description:
Media type typically expressed using a MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml) and [MDN reference](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/MIME_types)), e.g. application/zip for a SoftwareApplication binary, audio/mpeg for .mp3 etc.

In cases where a [[CreativeWork]] has several media type representations, [[encoding]] can be used to indicate each [[MediaObject]] alongside particular [[encodingFormat]] information.

Unregistered or niche encoding and file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia/Wikidata entry.

nodes.label: encodingType
nodes.description: The supported encoding type(s) for an EntryPoint request.

nodes.label: encodings
nodes.description: A media object that encodes this CreativeWork.

nodes.label: endDate
nodes.description: The end date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

nodes.label: endOffset
nodes.description: The end time of the clip expressed as the number of seconds from the beginning of the work.

nodes.label: endTime
nodes.description: The endTime of something. For a reserved event or service (e.g. FoodEstablishmentReservation), the time that it is expected to end. For actions that span a period of time, when the action was performed. E.g. John wrote a book from January to *December*. For media, including audio and video, it's the time offset of the end of a clip within a larger file.\n\nNote that Event uses startDate/endDate instead of startTime/endTime, even when describing dates with times. This situation may be clarified in future revisions.

nodes.label: endorsee
nodes.description: A sub property of participant. The person/organization being supported.

nodes.label: endorsers
nodes.description: People or organizations that endorse the plan.

nodes.label: energyEfficiencyScaleMax
nodes.description: Specifies the most energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

nodes.label: energyEfficiencyScaleMin
nodes.description: Specifies the least energy efficient class on the regulated EU energy consumption scale for the product category a product belongs to. For example, energy consumption for televisions placed on the market after January 1, 2020 is scaled from D to A+++.

nodes.label: engineDisplacement
nodes.description:
The volume swept by all of the pistons inside the cylinders of an internal combustion engine in a single movement. 

Typical unit code(s): CMQ for cubic centimeter, LTR for liters, INQ for cubic inches
* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

nodes.label: enginePower
nodes.description:
The power of the vehicle's engine.
    Typical unit code(s): KWT for kilowatt, BHP for brake horsepower, N12 for metric horsepower (PS, with 1 PS = 735,49875 W)

* Note 1: There are many different ways of measuring an engine's power. For an overview, see  [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine\_power\_test\_codes](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Horsepower#Engine_power_test_codes).
* Note 2: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 3: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

nodes.label: engineType
nodes.description: The type of engine or engines powering the vehicle.

nodes.label: entertainmentBusiness
nodes.description: A sub property of location. The entertainment business where the action occurred.

nodes.label: epidemiology
nodes.description: The characteristics of associated patients, such as age, gender, race etc.

nodes.label: episode
nodes.description: An episode of a TV, radio or game media within a series or season.

nodes.label: episodeNumber
nodes.description: Position of the episode within an ordered group of episodes.

nodes.label: episodes
nodes.description: An episode of a TV/radio series or season.

nodes.label: equal
nodes.description: This ordering relation for qualitative values indicates that the subject is equal to the object.

nodes.label: error
nodes.description: For failed actions, more information on the cause of the failure. Consider using the Error type.

nodes.label: errorCode
nodes.description: Application or platform dependant error code.

nodes.label: estimatedCost
nodes.description: The estimated cost of the supply or supplies consumed when performing instructions.

nodes.label: estimatedFlightDuration
nodes.description: The estimated time the flight will take.

nodes.label: estimatedSalary
nodes.description: An estimated salary for a job posting or occupation, based on a variety of variables including, but not limited to industry, job title, and location. Estimated salaries  are often computed by outside organizations rather than the hiring organization, who may not have committed to the estimated value.

nodes.label: estimatesRiskOf
nodes.description: The condition, complication, or symptom whose risk is being estimated.

nodes.label: ethicsPolicy
nodes.description: Statement about ethics policy, e.g. of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] regarding journalistic and publishing practices, or of a [[Restaurant]], a page describing food source policies. In the case of a [[NewsMediaOrganization]], an ethicsPolicy is typically a statement describing the personal, organizational, and corporate standards of behavior expected by the organization.

nodes.label: event
nodes.description: Upcoming or past event associated with this place, organization, or action.

nodes.label: eventAttendanceMode
nodes.description: The eventAttendanceMode of an event indicates whether it occurs online, offline, or a mix.

nodes.label: eventSchedule
nodes.description:
Associates an [[Event]] with a [[Schedule]]. There are circumstances where it is preferable to share a schedule for a series of
      repeating events rather than data on the individual events themselves. For example, a website or application might prefer to publish a schedule for a weekly
      gym class rather than provide data on every event. A schedule could be processed by applications to add forthcoming events to a calendar. An [[Event]] that
      is associated with a [[Schedule]] using this property should not have [[startDate]] or [[endDate]] properties. These are instead defined within the associated
      [[Schedule]], this avoids any ambiguity for clients using the data. The property might have repeated values to specify different schedules, e.g. for different months
      or seasons.

nodes.label: eventStatus
nodes.description: An eventStatus of an event represents its status; particularly useful when an event is cancelled or rescheduled.

nodes.label: events
nodes.description: Upcoming or past events associated with this place or organization.

nodes.label: evidenceLevel
nodes.description: Strength of evidence of the data used to formulate the guideline (enumerated).

nodes.label: evidenceOrigin
nodes.description: Source of the data used to formulate the guidance, e.g. RCT, consensus opinion, etc.

nodes.label: exampleOfWork
nodes.description: A creative work that this work is an example/instance/realization/derivation of.

nodes.label: exceptDate
nodes.description:
Defines a [[Date]] or [[DateTime]] during which a scheduled [[Event]] will not take place. The property allows exceptions to
      a [[Schedule]] to be specified. If an exception is specified as a [[DateTime]] then only the event that would have started at that specific date and time
      should be excluded from the schedule. If an exception is specified as a [[Date]] then any event that is scheduled for that 24 hour period should be
      excluded from the schedule. This allows a whole day to be excluded from the schedule without having to itemise every scheduled event.

nodes.label: exchangeRateSpread
nodes.description: The difference between the price at which a broker or other intermediary buys and sells foreign currency.

nodes.label: executableLibraryName
nodes.description: Library file name, e.g., mscorlib.dll, system.web.dll.

nodes.label: exerciseCourse
nodes.description: A sub property of location. The course where this action was taken.

nodes.label: exercisePlan
nodes.description: A sub property of instrument. The exercise plan used on this action.

nodes.label: exerciseRelatedDiet
nodes.description: A sub property of instrument. The diet used in this action.

nodes.label: exerciseType
nodes.description: Type(s) of exercise or activity, such as strength training, flexibility training, aerobics, cardiac rehabilitation, etc.

nodes.label: exifData
nodes.description: exif data for this object.

nodes.label: expectedArrivalFrom
nodes.description: The earliest date the package may arrive.

nodes.label: expectedArrivalUntil
nodes.description: The latest date the package may arrive.

nodes.label: expectedPrognosis
nodes.description: The likely outcome in either the short term or long term of the medical condition.

nodes.label: expectsAcceptanceOf
nodes.description: An Offer which must be accepted before the user can perform the Action. For example, the user may need to buy a movie before being able to watch it.

nodes.label: experienceInPlaceOfEducation
nodes.description: Indicates whether a [[JobPosting]] will accept experience (as indicated by [[OccupationalExperienceRequirements]]) in place of its formal educational qualifications (as indicated by [[educationRequirements]]). If true, indicates that satisfying one of these requirements is sufficient.

nodes.label: experienceRequirements
nodes.description: Description of skills and experience needed for the position or Occupation.

nodes.label: expertConsiderations
nodes.description: Medical expert advice related to the plan.

nodes.label: expires
nodes.description: Date the content expires and is no longer useful or available. For example a [[VideoObject]] or [[NewsArticle]] whose availability or relevance is time-limited, a [[ClaimReview]] fact check whose publisher wants to indicate that it may no longer be relevant (or helpful to highlight) after some date, or a [[Certification]] the validity has expired.

nodes.label: expressedIn
nodes.description: Tissue, organ, biological sample, etc in which activity of this gene has been observed experimentally. For example brain, digestive system.

nodes.label: extendedAddress
nodes.description: An address extension such as an apartment number, C/O or alternative name.

nodes.label: familyName
nodes.description: Family name. In the U.S., the last name of a Person.

nodes.label: fatContent
nodes.description: The number of grams of fat.

nodes.label: faxNumber
nodes.description: The fax number.

nodes.label: featureList
nodes.description: Features or modules provided by this application (and possibly required by other applications).

nodes.label: feesAndCommissionsSpecification
nodes.description: Description of fees, commissions, and other terms applied either to a class of financial product, or by a financial service organization.

nodes.label: fiberContent
nodes.description: The number of grams of fiber.

nodes.label: fileFormat
nodes.description: Media type, typically MIME format (see [IANA site](http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/media-types.xhtml)) of the content, e.g. application/zip of a SoftwareApplication binary. In cases where a CreativeWork has several media type representations, 'encoding' can be used to indicate each MediaObject alongside particular fileFormat information. Unregistered or niche file formats can be indicated instead via the most appropriate URL, e.g. defining Web page or a Wikipedia entry.

nodes.label: fileSize
nodes.description: Size of the application / package (e.g. 18MB). In the absence of a unit (MB, KB etc.), KB will be assumed.

nodes.label: financialAidEligible
nodes.description: A financial aid type or program which students may use to pay for tuition or fees associated with the program.

nodes.label: firstAppearance
nodes.description: Indicates the first known occurrence of a [[Claim]] in some [[CreativeWork]].

nodes.label: firstPerformance
nodes.description: The date and place the work was first performed.

nodes.label: flightDistance
nodes.description: The distance of the flight.

nodes.label: flightNumber
nodes.description: The unique identifier for a flight including the airline IATA code. For example, if describing United flight 110, where the IATA code for United is 'UA', the flightNumber is 'UA110'.

nodes.label: floorLevel
nodes.description:
The floor level for an [[Accommodation]] in a multi-storey building. Since counting
  systems [vary internationally](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Storey#Consecutive_number_floor_designations), the local system should be used where possible.

nodes.label: floorLimit
nodes.description: A floor limit is the amount of money above which credit card transactions must be authorized.

nodes.label: floorSize
nodes.description:
The size of the accommodation, e.g. in square meter or squarefoot.
Typical unit code(s): MTK for square meter, FTK for square foot, or YDK for square yard.

nodes.label: followee
nodes.description: A sub property of object. The person or organization being followed.

nodes.label: follows
nodes.description: The most generic uni-directional social relation.

nodes.label: followup
nodes.description: Typical or recommended followup care after the procedure is performed.

nodes.label: foodEstablishment
nodes.description: A sub property of location. The specific food establishment where the action occurred.

nodes.label: foodEvent
nodes.description: A sub property of location. The specific food event where the action occurred.

nodes.label: foodWarning
nodes.description: Any precaution, guidance, contraindication, etc. related to consumption of specific foods while taking this drug.

nodes.label: founder
nodes.description: A person or organization who founded this organization.

nodes.label: founders
nodes.description: A person who founded this organization.

nodes.label: foundingDate
nodes.description: The date that this organization was founded.

nodes.label: foundingLocation
nodes.description: The place where the Organization was founded.

nodes.label: free
nodes.description: A flag to signal that the item, event, or place is accessible for free.

nodes.label: freeShippingThreshold
nodes.description: A monetary value above (or at) which the shipping rate becomes free. Intended to be used via an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with [[shippingSettingsLink]] matching this [[ShippingRateSettings]].

nodes.label: frequency
nodes.description: How often the dose is taken, e.g. 'daily'.

nodes.label: fromLocation
nodes.description: A sub property of location. The original location of the object or the agent before the action.

nodes.label: fuelCapacity
nodes.description: The capacity of the fuel tank or in the case of electric cars, the battery. If there are multiple components for storage, this should indicate the total of all storage of the same type.\n\nTypical unit code(s): LTR for liters, GLL of US gallons, GLI for UK / imperial gallons, AMH for ampere-hours (for electrical vehicles).

nodes.label: fuelConsumption
nodes.description:
The amount of fuel consumed for traveling a particular distance or temporal duration with the given vehicle (e.g. liters per 100 km).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for liters per 100 km.  Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. L/100 km.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel consumption to another value.

nodes.label: fuelEfficiency
nodes.description:
The distance traveled per unit of fuel used; most commonly miles per gallon (mpg) or kilometers per liter (km/L).

* Note 1: There are unfortunately no standard unit codes for miles per gallon or kilometers per liter. Use [[unitText]] to indicate the unit of measurement, e.g. mpg or km/L.
* Note 2: There are two ways of indicating the fuel consumption, [[fuelConsumption]] (e.g. 8 liters per 100 km) and [[fuelEfficiency]] (e.g. 30 miles per gallon). They are reciprocal.
* Note 3: Often, the absolute value is useful only when related to driving speed ("at 80 km/h") or usage pattern ("city traffic"). You can use [[valueReference]] to link the value for the fuel economy to another value.

nodes.label: fuelType
nodes.description: The type of fuel suitable for the engine or engines of the vehicle. If the vehicle has only one engine, this property can be attached directly to the vehicle.

nodes.label: fulfillmentType
nodes.description: Type of fulfillment applicable to the [[ShippingService]].

nodes.label: functionalClass
nodes.description: The degree of mobility the joint allows.

nodes.label: fundedItem
nodes.description: Indicates something directly or indirectly funded or sponsored through a [[Grant]]. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].

nodes.label: funder
nodes.description: A person or organization that supports (sponsors) something through some kind of financial contribution.

nodes.label: funding
nodes.description: A [[Grant]] that directly or indirectly provide funding or sponsorship for this item. See also [[ownershipFundingInfo]].

nodes.label: game
nodes.description: Video game which is played on this server.

nodes.label: gameAvailabilityType
nodes.description: Indicates the availability type of the game content associated with this action, such as whether it is a full version or a demo.

nodes.label: gameEdition
nodes.description: The edition of a video game.

nodes.label: gameItem
nodes.description: An item is an object within the game world that can be collected by a player or, occasionally, a non-player character.

nodes.label: gameLocation
nodes.description: Real or fictional location of the game (or part of game).

nodes.label: gamePlatform
nodes.description: The electronic systems used to play video games.

nodes.label: gameServer
nodes.description: The server on which  it is possible to play the game.

nodes.label: gameTip
nodes.description: Links to tips, tactics, etc.

nodes.label: gender
nodes.description: Gender of something, typically a [[Person]], but possibly also fictional characters, animals, etc. While https://schema.org/Male and https://schema.org/Female may be used, text strings are also acceptable for people who are not a binary gender. The [[gender]] property can also be used in an extended sense to cover e.g. the gender of sports teams. As with the gender of individuals, we do not try to enumerate all possibilities. A mixed-gender [[SportsTeam]] can be indicated with a text value of "Mixed".

nodes.label: genre
nodes.description: Genre of the creative work, broadcast channel or group.

nodes.label: geo
nodes.description: The geo coordinates of the place.

nodes.label: geoContains
nodes.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a containing geometry to a contained geometry. "a contains b iff no points of b lie in the exterior of a, and at least one point of the interior of b lies in the interior of a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

nodes.label: geoCoveredBy
nodes.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that covers it. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

nodes.label: geoCovers
nodes.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a covering geometry to a covered geometry. "Every point of b is a point of (the interior or boundary of) a". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

nodes.label: geoCrosses
nodes.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that crosses it: "a crosses b: they have some but not all interior points in common, and the dimension of the intersection is less than that of at least one of them". As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

nodes.label: geoDisjoint
nodes.description: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically disjoint: "they have no point in common. They form a set of disconnected geometries." (A symmetric relationship, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).)

nodes.label: geoEquals
nodes.description: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) are topologically equal, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM). "Two geometries are topologically equal if their interiors intersect and no part of the interior or boundary of one geometry intersects the exterior of the other" (a symmetric relationship).

nodes.label: geoIntersects
nodes.description: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) have at least one point in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

nodes.label: geoMidpoint
nodes.description: Indicates the GeoCoordinates at the centre of a GeoShape, e.g. GeoCircle.

nodes.label: geoOverlaps
nodes.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to another that geospatially overlaps it, i.e. they have some but not all points in common. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

nodes.label: geoRadius
nodes.description: Indicates the approximate radius of a GeoCircle (metres unless indicated otherwise via Distance notation).

nodes.label: geoTouches
nodes.description: Represents spatial relations in which two geometries (or the places they represent) touch: "they have at least one boundary point in common, but no interior points." (A symmetric relationship, as defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).)

nodes.label: geoWithin
nodes.description: Represents a relationship between two geometries (or the places they represent), relating a geometry to one that contains it, i.e. it is inside (i.e. within) its interior. As defined in [DE-9IM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DE-9IM).

nodes.label: geographicArea
nodes.description: The geographic area associated with the audience.

nodes.label: gettingTestedInfo
nodes.description: Information about getting tested (for a [[MedicalCondition]]), e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

nodes.label: givenName
nodes.description: Given name. In the U.S., the first name of a Person.

nodes.label: globalLocationNumber
nodes.description: The [Global Location Number](http://www.gs1.org/gln) (GLN, sometimes also referred to as International Location Number or ILN) of the respective organization, person, or place. The GLN is a 13-digit number used to identify parties and physical locations.

nodes.label: governmentBenefitsInfo
nodes.description: governmentBenefitsInfo provides information about government benefits associated with a SpecialAnnouncement.

nodes.label: gracePeriod

nodes.label: gtin
nodes.description:
A Global Trade Item Number ([GTIN](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin)). GTINs identify trade items, including products and services, using numeric identification codes.

A correct [[gtin]] value should be a valid GTIN, which means that it should be an all-numeric string of either 8, 12, 13 or 14 digits, or a "GS1 Digital Link" URL based on such a string. The numeric component should also have a [valid GS1 check digit](https://www.gs1.org/services/check-digit-calculator) and meet the other rules for valid GTINs. See also [GS1's GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) and [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Global_Trade_Item_Number) for more details. Left-padding of the gtin values is not required or encouraged. The [[gtin]] property generalizes the earlier [[gtin8]], [[gtin12]], [[gtin13]], and [[gtin14]] properties.

The GS1 [digital link specifications](https://www.gs1.org/standards/Digital-Link/) expresses GTINs as URLs (URIs, IRIs, etc.).
Digital Links should be populated into the [[hasGS1DigitalLink]] attribute.

Note also that this is a definition for how to include GTINs in Schema.org data, and not a definition of GTINs in general - see the GS1 documentation for authoritative details.

nodes.label: gtin12
nodes.description: The GTIN-12 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. The GTIN-12 is the 12-digit GS1 Identification Key composed of a U.P.C. Company Prefix, Item Reference, and Check Digit used to identify trade items. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

nodes.label: gtin13
nodes.description: The GTIN-13 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. This is equivalent to 13-digit ISBN codes and EAN UCC-13. Former 12-digit UPC codes can be converted into a GTIN-13 code by simply adding a preceding zero. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

nodes.label: gtin14
nodes.description: The GTIN-14 code of the product, or the product to which the offer refers. See [GS1 GTIN Summary](http://www.gs1.org/barcodes/technical/idkeys/gtin) for more details.

nodes.label: gtin8

nodes.label: hasGS1DigitalLink
nodes.description:
The GS1 digital link associated with the object. This URL should conform to the particular requirements of digital links. The link should only contain the Application Identifiers (AIs) that are relevant for the entity being annotated, for instance a [[Product]] or an [[Organization]], and for the correct granularity. In particular, for products:
  • A Digital Link that contains a serial number (AI 21) should only be present on instances of [[IndividualProduct]]
  • A Digital Link that contains a lot number (AI 10) should be annotated as [[SomeProducts]] if only products from that lot are sold, or [[IndividualProduct]] if there is only a specific product.
  • A Digital Link that contains a global model number (AI 8013) should be attached to a [[Product]] or a [[ProductModel]].
Other item types should be adapted similarly.

nodes.label: incentiveAmount
nodes.description:
Describes the amount that can be redeemed from this incentive.

[[QuantitativeValue]]: Use this for incentives based on price (either raw amount or percentage-based). For a raw amount example, "You can claim $2,500 - $7,500 from the total cost of installation" would be represented as the following:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", “minValue”: 2500, “maxValue”: 7500, "unitCode": "USD" }

[[QuantitativeValue]] can also be used for percentage amounts. In such cases, value is used to represent the incentive’s percentage, while maxValue represents a limit (if one exists) to that incentive. The unitCode should be 'P1' and the unitText should be '%', while valueReference should be used for holding the currency type. For example, "You can claim up to 30% of the total cost of installation, up to a maximum of $7,500" would be:

{ "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "value": 30, "unitCode": "P1", "unitText": "%", “maxValue”: 7500, “valueReference”: “USD” }

[[UnitPriceSpecification]]: Use this for incentives that are based on amounts rather than price. For example, a net metering rebate that pays $10/kWh, up to $1,000:

{ "@type": "UnitPriceSpecification", "price": 10, "priceCurrency": "USD", "referenceQuantity": 1, "unitCode": "DO3", "unitText": "kw/h", "maxPrice": 1000, "description": "$10 / kwh up to $1000" }

[[LoanOrCredit]]: Use for incentives that are loan based. For example, a loan of $4,000 - $50,000 with a repayment term of 10 years, interest free would look like:

{ "@type": "LoanOrCredit", "loanTerm": { "@type":"QuantitativeValue", "value":"10", "unitCode": "ANN" }, "amount":[ { "@type": "QuantitativeValue", "Name":"fixed interest rate", "value":"0", }, ], "amount":[ { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"min loan amount", "value":"4000", "currency":"CAD" }, { "@type": "MonetaryAmount", "Name":"max loan amount", "value":"50000", "currency":"CAD" } ], } In summary:
  • Use [[QuantitativeValue]] for absolute/percentage-based incentives applied on the price of a good/service.
  • Use [[UnitPriceSpecification]] for incentives based on a per-unit basis (e.g. net metering).
  • Use [[LoanOrCredit]] for loans/credits.
.

nodes.label: isVariantOf

It is safe to infer that the variant inherits all product features from the base model, unless defined locally. This is not transitive. In the case of a [[ProductGroup]], the group description also serves as a template, representing a set of Products that vary on explicitly defined, specific dimensions only (so it defines both a set of variants, as well as which values distinguish amongst those variants). When used with [[ProductGroup]], this property can apply to any [[Product]] included in the group.
