The speed range of the vehicle. If the vehicle is powered by an engine, the upper limit of the speed range (indicated by [[maxValue]]) should be the maximum speed achievable under regular conditions.

Typical unit code(s): KMH for km/h, HM for mile per hour (0.447 04 m/s), KNT for knot

*Note 1: Use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate the range. Typically, the minimal value is zero.
* Note 2: There are many different ways of measuring the speed range. You can link to information about how the given value has been determined using the [[valueReference]] property.

nodes.label: spokenByCharacter
nodes.description: The (e.g. fictional) character, Person or Organization to whom the quotation is attributed within the containing CreativeWork.

nodes.label: sponsor
nodes.description: A person or organization that supports a thing through a pledge, promise, or financial contribution. E.g. a sponsor of a Medical Study or a corporate sponsor of an event.

nodes.label: sport
nodes.description: A type of sport (e.g. Baseball).

nodes.label: sportsActivityLocation
nodes.description: A sub property of location. The sports activity location where this action occurred.

nodes.label: sportsEvent
nodes.description: A sub property of location. The sports event where this action occurred.

nodes.label: sportsTeam
nodes.description: A sub property of participant. The sports team that participated on this action.

nodes.label: spouse
nodes.description: The person's spouse.

nodes.label: stage
nodes.description: The stage of the condition, if applicable.

nodes.label: stageAsNumber
nodes.description: The stage represented as a number, e.g. 3.

nodes.label: starRating
nodes.description: An official rating for a lodging business or food establishment, e.g. from national associations or standards bodies. Use the author property to indicate the rating organization, e.g. as an Organization with name such as (e.g. HOTREC, DEHOGA, WHR, or Hotelstars).

nodes.label: startDate
nodes.description: The start date and time of the item (in [ISO 8601 date format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601)).

nodes.label: startOffset
nodes.description: The start time of the clip expressed as the number of seconds from the beginning of the work.

nodes.label: startTime
nodes.description: The startTime of something. For a reserved event or service (e.g. FoodEstablishmentReservation), the time that it is expected to start. For actions that span a period of time, when the action was performed. E.g. John wrote a book from *January* to December. For media, including audio and video, it's the time offset of the start of a clip within a larger file.\n\nNote that Event uses startDate/endDate instead of startTime/endTime, even when describing dates with times. This situation may be clarified in future revisions.

nodes.label: statType
nodes.description: Indicates the kind of statistic represented by a [[StatisticalVariable]], e.g. mean, count etc. The value of statType is a property, either from within Schema.org (e.g. [[median]], [[marginOfError]], [[maxValue]], [[minValue]]) or from other compatible (e.g. RDF) systems such as DataCommons.org or Wikidata.org.

nodes.label: status
nodes.description: The status of the study (enumerated).

nodes.label: steeringPosition
nodes.description: The position of the steering wheel or similar device (mostly for cars).

nodes.label: step
nodes.description: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection.

nodes.label: stepValue
nodes.description: The stepValue attribute indicates the granularity that is expected (and required) of the value in a PropertyValueSpecification.

nodes.label: steps
nodes.description: A single step item (as HowToStep, text, document, video, etc.) or a HowToSection (originally misnamed 'steps'; 'step' is preferred).

nodes.label: storageRequirements
nodes.description: Storage requirements (free space required).

nodes.label: streetAddress
nodes.description: The street address. For example, 1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy.

nodes.label: strengthUnit
nodes.description: The units of an active ingredient's strength, e.g. mg.

nodes.label: strengthValue
nodes.description: The value of an active ingredient's strength, e.g. 325.

nodes.label: structuralClass
nodes.description: The name given to how bone physically connects to each other.

nodes.label: study
nodes.description: A medical study or trial related to this entity.

nodes.label: studyDesign
nodes.description: Specifics about the observational study design (enumerated).

nodes.label: studyLocation
nodes.description: The location in which the study is taking/took place.

nodes.label: studySubject
nodes.description: A subject of the study, i.e. one of the medical conditions, therapies, devices, drugs, etc. investigated by the study.

nodes.label: subEvent
nodes.description: An Event that is part of this event. For example, a conference event includes many presentations, each of which is a subEvent of the conference.

nodes.label: subEvents
nodes.description: Events that are a part of this event. For example, a conference event includes many presentations, each subEvents of the conference.

nodes.label: subOrganization
nodes.description: A relationship between two organizations where the first includes the second, e.g., as a subsidiary. See also: the more specific 'department' property.

nodes.label: subReservation
nodes.description: The individual reservations included in the package. Typically a repeated property.

nodes.label: subStageSuffix
nodes.description: The substage, e.g. 'a' for Stage IIIa.

nodes.label: subStructure
nodes.description: Component (sub-)structure(s) that comprise this anatomical structure.

nodes.label: subTest
nodes.description: A component test of the panel.

nodes.label: subTrip
nodes.description: Identifies a [[Trip]] that is a subTrip of this Trip.  For example Day 1, Day 2, etc. of a multi-day trip.

nodes.label: subjectOf
nodes.description: A CreativeWork or Event about this Thing.

nodes.label: substanceOfConcern
nodes.description: A substance of concern (SoC) contained within the product, typically based on regulatory lists like REACH or RoHS.

nodes.label: subtitleLanguage
nodes.description: Languages in which subtitles/captions are available, in [IETF BCP 47 standard format](http://tools.ietf.org/html/bcp47).

nodes.label: successorOf
nodes.description: A pointer from a newer variant of a product  to its previous, often discontinued predecessor.

nodes.label: sugarContent
nodes.description: The number of grams of sugar.

nodes.label: suggestedAge
nodes.description: The age or age range for the intended audience or person, for example 3-12 months for infants, 1-5 years for toddlers.

nodes.label: suggestedAnswer
nodes.description: An answer (possibly one of several, possibly incorrect) to a Question, e.g. on a Question/Answer site.

nodes.label: suggestedGender
nodes.description: The suggested gender of the intended person or audience, for example "male", "female", or "unisex".

nodes.label: suggestedMaxAge
nodes.description: Maximum recommended age in years for the audience or user.

nodes.label: suggestedMeasurement
nodes.description: A suggested range of body measurements for the intended audience or person, for example inseam between 32 and 34 inches or height between 170 and 190 cm. Typically found on a size chart for wearable products.

nodes.label: suggestedMinAge
nodes.description: Minimum recommended age in years for the audience or user.

nodes.label: suitableForDiet
nodes.description: Indicates a dietary restriction or guideline for which this recipe or menu item is suitable, e.g. diabetic, halal etc.

nodes.label: superEvent
nodes.description: An event that this event is a part of. For example, a collection of individual music performances might each have a music festival as their superEvent.

nodes.label: supersededBy
nodes.description: Relates a term (i.e. a property, class or enumeration) to one that supersedes it.

nodes.label: supply
nodes.description: A sub-property of instrument. A supply consumed when performing instructions or a direction.

nodes.label: supplyTo
nodes.description: The area to which the artery supplies blood.

nodes.label: supportingData
nodes.description: Supporting data for a SoftwareApplication.

nodes.label: surface
nodes.description: A material used as a surface in some artwork, e.g. Canvas, Paper, Wood, Board, etc.

nodes.label: syllabusSections
nodes.description: Indicates (typically several) Syllabus entities that lay out what each section of the overall course will cover.

nodes.label: target
nodes.description: Indicates a target EntryPoint, or url, for an Action.

nodes.label: targetCollection
nodes.description: A sub property of object. The collection target of the action.

nodes.label: targetDescription
nodes.description: The description of a node in an established educational framework.

nodes.label: targetName
nodes.description: The name of a node in an established educational framework.

nodes.label: targetPlatform
nodes.description: Type of app development: phone, Metro style, desktop, XBox, etc.

nodes.label: targetPopulation
nodes.description: Characteristics of the population for which this is intended, or which typically uses it, e.g. 'adults'.

nodes.label: targetProduct
nodes.description: Target Operating System / Product to which the code applies.  If applies to several versions, just the product name can be used.

nodes.label: targetUrl
nodes.description: The URL of a node in an established educational framework.

nodes.label: taxID
nodes.description: The Tax / Fiscal ID of the organization or person, e.g. the TIN in the US or the CIF/NIF in Spain.

nodes.label: taxonRank
nodes.description: The taxonomic rank of this taxon given preferably as a URI from a controlled vocabulary – typically the ranks from TDWG TaxonRank ontology or equivalent Wikidata URIs.

nodes.label: taxonomicRange
nodes.description: The taxonomic grouping of the organism that expresses, encodes, or in some way related to the BioChemEntity.

nodes.label: teaches
nodes.description: The item being described is intended to help a person learn the competency or learning outcome defined by the referenced term.

nodes.label: telephone
nodes.description: The telephone number.

nodes.label: temporal
nodes.description:
The "temporal" property can be used in cases where more specific properties
(e.g. [[temporalCoverage]], [[dateCreated]], [[dateModified]], [[datePublished]]) are not known to be appropriate.

nodes.label: temporalCoverage
nodes.description:
The temporalCoverage of a CreativeWork indicates the period that the content applies to, i.e. that it describes, either as a DateTime or as a textual string indicating a time period in [ISO 8601 time interval format](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601#Time_intervals). In
      the case of a Dataset it will typically indicate the relevant time period in a precise notation (e.g. for a 2011 census dataset, the year 2011 would be written "2011/2012"). Other forms of content, e.g. ScholarlyArticle, Book, TVSeries or TVEpisode, may indicate their temporalCoverage in broader terms - textually or via well-known URL.
      Written works such as books may sometimes have precise temporal coverage too, e.g. a work set in 1939 - 1945 can be indicated in ISO 8601 interval format format via "1939/1945".

Open-ended date ranges can be written with ".." in place of the end date. For example, "2015-11/.." indicates a range beginning in November 2015 and with no specified final date. This is tentative and might be updated in future when ISO 8601 is officially updated.

nodes.label: termCode
nodes.description: A code that identifies this [[DefinedTerm]] within a [[DefinedTermSet]].

nodes.label: termDuration
nodes.description: The amount of time in a term as defined by the institution. A term is a length of time where students take one or more classes. Semesters and quarters are common units for term.

nodes.label: termsOfService
nodes.description: Human-readable terms of service documentation.

nodes.label: termsPerYear
nodes.description: The number of times terms of study are offered per year. Semesters and quarters are common units for term. For example, if the student can only take 2 semesters for the program in one year, then termsPerYear should be 2.

nodes.label: text
nodes.description: The textual content of this CreativeWork.

nodes.label: textValue
nodes.description: Text value being annotated.

nodes.label: thumbnail
nodes.description: Thumbnail image for an image or video.

nodes.label: thumbnailUrl
nodes.description: A thumbnail image relevant to the Thing.

nodes.label: tickerSymbol
nodes.description: The exchange traded instrument associated with a Corporation object. The tickerSymbol is expressed as an exchange and an instrument name separated by a space character. For the exchange component of the tickerSymbol attribute, we recommend using the controlled vocabulary of Market Identifier Codes (MIC) specified in ISO 15022.

nodes.label: ticketNumber
nodes.description: The unique identifier for the ticket.

nodes.label: ticketToken
nodes.description: Reference to an asset (e.g., Barcode, QR code image or PDF) usable for entrance.

nodes.label: ticketedSeat
nodes.description: The seat associated with the ticket.

nodes.label: timeOfDay
nodes.description: The time of day the program normally runs. For example, "evenings".

nodes.label: timeRequired
nodes.description: Approximate or typical time it usually takes to work with or through the content of this work for the typical or target audience.

nodes.label: timeToComplete
nodes.description: The expected length of time to complete the program if attending full-time.

nodes.label: timestamp
nodes.description: The instant the event occured.

nodes.label: tissueSample
nodes.description: The type of tissue sample required for the test.

nodes.label: title
nodes.description: The title of the job.

nodes.label: titleEIDR
nodes.description:
An [EIDR](https://eidr.org/) (Entertainment Identifier Registry) [[identifier]] representing at the most general/abstract level, a work of film or television.

For example, the motion picture known as "Ghostbusters" has a titleEIDR of  "10.5240/7EC7-228A-510A-053E-CBB8-J". This title (or work) may have several variants, which EIDR calls "edits". See [[editEIDR]].

Since schema.org types like [[Movie]], [[TVEpisode]], [[TVSeason]], and [[TVSeries]] can be used for both works and their multiple expressions, it is possible to use [[titleEIDR]] alone (for a general description), or alongside [[editEIDR]] for a more edit-specific description.

nodes.label: toLocation
nodes.description: A sub property of location. The final location of the object or the agent after the action.

nodes.label: toRecipient
nodes.description: A sub property of recipient. The recipient who was directly sent the message.

nodes.label: tocContinuation
nodes.description: A [[HyperTocEntry]] can have a [[tocContinuation]] indicated, which is another [[HyperTocEntry]] that would be the default next item to play or render.

nodes.label: tocEntry
nodes.description: Indicates a [[HyperTocEntry]] in a [[HyperToc]].

nodes.label: tongueWeight
nodes.description:
The permitted vertical load (TWR) of a trailer attached to the vehicle. Also referred to as Tongue Load Rating (TLR) or Vertical Load Rating (VLR).

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

nodes.label: tool
nodes.description: A sub property of instrument. An object used (but not consumed) when performing instructions or a direction.

nodes.label: torque
nodes.description:
The torque (turning force) of the vehicle's engine.

Typical unit code(s): NU for newton metre (N m), F17 for pound-force per foot, or F48 for pound-force per inch

* Note 1: You can link to information about how the given value has been determined (e.g. reference RPM) using the [[valueReference]] property.
* Note 2: You can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

nodes.label: totalHistoricalEnrollment
nodes.description: The total number of students that have enrolled in the history of the course.

nodes.label: totalJobOpenings
nodes.description: The number of positions open for this job posting. Use a positive integer. Do not use if the number of positions is unclear or not known.

nodes.label: totalPaymentDue
nodes.description: The total amount due.

nodes.label: totalPrice
nodes.description:
The total price for the reservation or ticket, including applicable taxes, shipping, etc.

Usage guidelines:

* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

nodes.label: totalTime
nodes.description: The total time required to perform instructions or a direction (including time to prepare the supplies), in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

nodes.label: tourBookingPage
nodes.description: A page providing information on how to book a tour of some [[Place]], such as an [[Accommodation]] or [[ApartmentComplex]] in a real estate setting, as well as other kinds of tours as appropriate.

nodes.label: touristType
nodes.description: Attraction suitable for type(s) of tourist. E.g. children, visitors from a particular country, etc.

nodes.label: track
nodes.description: A music recording (track)—usually a single song. If an ItemList is given, the list should contain items of type MusicRecording.

nodes.label: trackingNumber
nodes.description: Shipper tracking number.

nodes.label: trackingUrl
nodes.description: Tracking url for the parcel delivery.

nodes.label: tracks
nodes.description: A music recording (track)—usually a single song.

nodes.label: trailer
nodes.description: The trailer of a movie or TV/radio series, season, episode, etc.

nodes.label: trailerWeight
nodes.description:
The permitted weight of a trailer attached to the vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound
* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

nodes.label: trainName
nodes.description: The name of the train (e.g. The Orient Express).

nodes.label: trainNumber
nodes.description: The unique identifier for the train.

nodes.label: trainingSalary
nodes.description: The estimated salary earned while in the program.

nodes.label: transFatContent
nodes.description: The number of grams of trans fat.

nodes.label: transcript
nodes.description: If this MediaObject is an AudioObject or VideoObject, the transcript of that object.

nodes.label: transitTime
nodes.description:
The typical delay the order has been sent for delivery and the goods reach the final customer.

  In the context of [[ShippingDeliveryTime]], use the [[QuantitativeValue]]. Typical properties: minValue, maxValue, unitCode (d for DAY).

  In the context of [[ShippingConditions]], use the [[ServicePeriod]]. It has a duration (as a [[QuantitativeValue]]) and also business days and a cut-off time.

nodes.label: transitTimeLabel
nodes.description: Label to match an [[OfferShippingDetails]] with a [[DeliveryTimeSettings]] (within the context of a [[shippingSettingsLink]] cross-reference).

nodes.label: translationOfWork
nodes.description: The work that this work has been translated from. E.g. 物种起源 is a translationOf “On the Origin of Species”.

nodes.label: translator
nodes.description: Organization or person who adapts a creative work to different languages, regional differences and technical requirements of a target market, or that translates during some event.

nodes.label: transmissionMethod
nodes.description: How the disease spreads, either as a route or vector, for example 'direct contact', 'Aedes aegypti', etc.

nodes.label: travelBans
nodes.description: Information about travel bans, e.g. in the context of a pandemic.

nodes.label: trialDesign
nodes.description: Specifics about the trial design (enumerated).

nodes.label: tributary
nodes.description: The anatomical or organ system that the vein flows into; a larger structure that the vein connects to.

nodes.label: tripOrigin
nodes.description: The location of origin of the trip, prior to any destination(s).

nodes.label: typeOfBed
nodes.description: The type of bed to which the BedDetail refers, i.e. the type of bed available in the quantity indicated by quantity.

nodes.label: typeOfGood
nodes.description: The product that this structured value is referring to.

nodes.label: typicalAgeRange
nodes.description: The typical expected age range, e.g. '7-9', '11-'.

nodes.label: typicalCreditsPerTerm
nodes.description: The number of credits or units a full-time student would be expected to take in 1 term however 'term' is defined by the institution.

nodes.label: typicalTest
nodes.description: A medical test typically performed given this condition.

nodes.label: underName
nodes.description: The person or organization the reservation or ticket is for.

nodes.label: unitCode
nodes.description: The unit of measurement given using the UN/CEFACT Common Code (3 characters) or a URL. Other codes than the UN/CEFACT Common Code may be used with a prefix followed by a colon.

nodes.label: unitText
nodes.description: A string or text indicating the unit of measurement. Useful if you cannot provide a standard unit code for unitCode.

nodes.label: unnamedSourcesPolicy
nodes.description: For an [[Organization]] (typically a [[NewsMediaOrganization]]), a statement about policy on use of unnamed sources and the decision process required.

nodes.label: unsaturatedFatContent
nodes.description: The number of grams of unsaturated fat.

nodes.label: uploadDate
nodes.description: Date (including time if available) when this media object was uploaded to this site.

nodes.label: upvoteCount
nodes.description: The number of upvotes this question, answer or comment has received from the community.

nodes.label: url
nodes.description: URL of the item.

nodes.label: urlTemplate
nodes.description: An url template (RFC6570) that will be used to construct the target of the execution of the action.

nodes.label: usNPI
nodes.description: A National Provider Identifier (NPI) is a unique 10-digit identification number issued to health care providers in the United States by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.

nodes.label: usageInfo
nodes.description:
The schema.org [[usageInfo]] property indicates further information about a [[CreativeWork]]. This property is applicable both to works that are freely available and to those that require payment or other transactions. It can reference additional information, e.g. community expectations on preferred linking and citation conventions, as well as purchasing details. For something that can be commercially licensed, usageInfo can provide detailed, resource-specific information about licensing options.

This property can be used alongside the license property which indicates license(s) applicable to some piece of content. The usageInfo property can provide information about other licensing options, e.g. acquiring commercial usage rights for an image that is also available under non-commercial creative commons licenses.

nodes.label: usedToDiagnose
nodes.description: A condition the test is used to diagnose.

nodes.label: userInteractionCount
nodes.description: The number of interactions for the CreativeWork using the WebSite or SoftwareApplication.

nodes.label: usesDevice
nodes.description: Device used to perform the test.

nodes.label: usesHealthPlanIdStandard
nodes.description: The standard for interpreting the Plan ID. The preferred is "HIOS". See the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services for more details.

nodes.label: utterances
nodes.description: Text of an utterances (spoken words, lyrics etc.) that occurs at a certain section of a media object, represented as a [[HyperTocEntry]].

nodes.label: validFor
nodes.description: The duration of validity of a permit or similar thing.

nodes.label: validForMemberTier
nodes.description: The membership program tier(s) an Offer (or a PriceSpecification, OfferShippingDetails, or MerchantReturnPolicy under an Offer) is valid for.

nodes.label: validFrom
nodes.description: The date when the item becomes valid.

nodes.label: validIn
nodes.description: The geographic area where the item is valid. Applies for example to a [[Permit]], a [[Certification]], or an [[EducationalOccupationalCredential]].

nodes.label: validThrough
nodes.description: The date after when the item is not valid. For example the end of an offer, salary period, or a period of opening hours.

nodes.label: validUntil
nodes.description: The date when the item is no longer valid.

nodes.label: value
nodes.description:
The value of a [[QuantitativeValue]] (including [[Observation]]) or property value node.

* For [[QuantitativeValue]] and [[MonetaryAmount]], the recommended type for values is 'Number'.
* For [[PropertyValue]], it can be 'Text', 'Number', 'Boolean', 'StructuredValue' or 'QualitativeValue'.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

nodes.label: valueAddedTaxIncluded
nodes.description: Specifies whether the applicable value-added tax (VAT) is included in the price specification or not.

nodes.label: valueGroup
nodes.description: A header or section name for grouping related property values.

nodes.label: valueMaxLength
nodes.description: Specifies the allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

nodes.label: valueMinLength
nodes.description: Specifies the minimum allowed range for number of characters in a literal value.

nodes.label: valueName
nodes.description: Indicates the name of the PropertyValueSpecification to be used in URL templates and form encoding in a manner analogous to HTML's input@name.

nodes.label: valuePattern
nodes.description: Specifies a regular expression for testing literal values according to the HTML spec.

nodes.label: valueReference
nodes.description: A secondary value that provides additional information on the original value, e.g. a reference temperature or a type of measurement.

nodes.label: valueRequired
nodes.description: Whether the property must be filled in to complete the action.  Default is false.

nodes.label: variableMeasured
nodes.description: The variableMeasured property can indicate (repeated as necessary) the  variables that are measured in some dataset, either described as text or as pairs of identifier and description using PropertyValue, or more explicitly as a [[StatisticalVariable]].

nodes.label: variantCover
nodes.description:
A description of the variant cover
    	for the issue, if the issue is a variant printing. For example, "Bryan Hitch
    	Variant Cover" or "2nd Printing Variant".

nodes.label: variesBy
nodes.description: Indicates the property or properties by which the variants in a [[ProductGroup]] vary, e.g. their size, color etc. Schema.org properties can be referenced by their short name e.g. "color"; terms defined elsewhere can be referenced with their URIs. Variant properties can be provided using [[PropertyValue]] instead of plain [[Text]], to allow specification of the values available for a variant property.

nodes.label: vatID
nodes.description: The value-added Tax ID of the organization or person with national prefix (for example IT123456789). Can also be described as [[iso6523Code]] with proper prefix.

nodes.label: vehicleConfiguration
nodes.description: A short text indicating the configuration of the vehicle, e.g. '5dr hatchback ST 2.5 MT 225 hp' or 'limited edition'.

nodes.label: vehicleEngine
nodes.description: Information about the engine or engines of the vehicle.

nodes.label: vehicleIdentificationNumber
nodes.description: The Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) is a unique serial number used by the automotive industry to identify individual motor vehicles.

nodes.label: vehicleInteriorColor
nodes.description: The color or color combination of the interior of the vehicle.

nodes.label: vehicleInteriorType
nodes.description: The type or material of the interior of the vehicle (e.g. synthetic fabric, leather, wood, etc.). While most interior types are characterized by the material used, an interior type can also be based on vehicle usage or target audience.

nodes.label: vehicleModelDate
nodes.description: The release date of a vehicle model (often used to differentiate versions of the same make and model).

nodes.label: vehicleSeatingCapacity
nodes.description: The number of passengers that can be seated in the vehicle, both in terms of the physical space available, and in terms of limitations set by law.\n\nTypical unit code(s): C62 for persons.

nodes.label: vehicleSpecialUsage
nodes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle has been used for special purposes, like commercial rental, driving school, or as a taxi. The legislation in many countries requires this information to be revealed when offering a car for sale.

nodes.label: vehicleTransmission
nodes.description: The type of component used for transmitting the power from a rotating power source to the wheels or other relevant component(s) ("gearbox" for cars).

nodes.label: vendor
nodes.description: 'vendor' is an earlier term for 'seller'.

nodes.label: verificationFactCheckingPolicy
nodes.description: Disclosure about verification and fact-checking processes for a [[NewsMediaOrganization]] or other fact-checking [[Organization]].

nodes.label: version
nodes.description: The version of the CreativeWork embodied by a specified resource.

nodes.label: video
nodes.description: An embedded video object.

nodes.label: videoFormat
nodes.description: The type of screening or video broadcast used (e.g. IMAX, 3D, SD, HD, etc.).

nodes.label: videoFrameSize
nodes.description: The frame size of the video.

nodes.label: videoQuality
nodes.description: The quality of the video.

nodes.label: volumeNumber
nodes.description: Identifies the volume of publication or multi-part work; for example, "iii" or "2".

nodes.label: warning
nodes.description: Any FDA or other warnings about the drug (text or URL).

nodes.label: warranty
nodes.description: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

nodes.label: warrantyPromise
nodes.description: The warranty promise(s) included in the offer.

nodes.label: warrantyScope
nodes.description: The scope of the warranty promise.

nodes.label: webCheckinTime
nodes.description: The time when a passenger can check into the flight online.

nodes.label: webFeed
nodes.description: The URL for a feed, e.g. associated with a podcast series, blog, or series of date-stamped updates. This is usually RSS or Atom.

nodes.label: weight
nodes.description: The weight of the product or person.

nodes.label: weightPercentage
nodes.description: Value representing the fraction of the weight that is used to compute the shipping price. Example: 0.10 and a shipping weight of 15kg would add $1.5 to the order price, where the $ is the currency of the order.

nodes.label: weightTotal
nodes.description:
The permitted total weight of the loaded vehicle, including passengers and cargo and the weight of the empty vehicle.

Typical unit code(s): KGM for kilogram, LBR for pound

* Note 1: You can indicate additional information in the [[name]] of the [[QuantitativeValue]] node.
* Note 2: You may also link to a [[QualitativeValue]] node that provides additional information using [[valueReference]].
* Note 3: Note that you can use [[minValue]] and [[maxValue]] to indicate ranges.

nodes.label: wheelbase
nodes.description: The distance between the centers of the front and rear wheels.\n\nTypical unit code(s): CMT for centimeters, MTR for meters, INH for inches, FOT for foot/feet.

nodes.label: width
nodes.description: The width of the item.

nodes.label: winner
nodes.description: A sub property of participant. The winner of the action.

nodes.label: wordCount
nodes.description: The number of words in the text of the CreativeWork such as an Article, Book, etc.

nodes.label: workExample
nodes.description: Example/instance/realization/derivation of the concept of this creative work. E.g. the paperback edition, first edition, or e-book.

nodes.label: workFeatured
nodes.description:
A work featured in some event, e.g. exhibited in an ExhibitionEvent.
       Specific subproperties are available for workPerformed (e.g. a play), or a workPresented (a Movie at a ScreeningEvent).

nodes.label: workHours
nodes.description: The typical working hours for this job (e.g. 1st shift, night shift, 8am-5pm).

nodes.label: workLocation
nodes.description: A contact location for a person's place of work.

nodes.label: workPerformed
nodes.description: A work performed in some event, for example a play performed in a TheaterEvent.

nodes.label: workPresented
nodes.description: The movie presented during this event.

nodes.label: workTranslation
nodes.description: A work that is a translation of the content of this work. E.g. 西遊記 has an English workTranslation “Journey to the West”, a German workTranslation “Monkeys Pilgerfahrt” and a Vietnamese  translation Tây du ký bình khảo.

nodes.label: workload
nodes.description: Quantitative measure of the physiologic output of the exercise; also referred to as energy expenditure.

nodes.label: worksFor
nodes.description: Organizations that the person works for.

nodes.label: worstRating
nodes.description: The lowest value allowed in this rating system.

nodes.label: xpath
nodes.description: An XPath, e.g. of a [[SpeakableSpecification]] or [[WebPageElement]]. In the latter case, multiple matches within a page can constitute a single conceptual "Web page element".

nodes.label: yearBuilt
nodes.description: The year an [[Accommodation]] was constructed. This corresponds to the [YearBuilt field in RESO](https://ddwiki.reso.org/display/DDW17/YearBuilt+Field).

nodes.label: yearlyRevenue
nodes.description: The size of the business in annual revenue.

nodes.label: yearsInOperation
nodes.description: The age of the business.

nodes.label: yield
nodes.description: The quantity that results by performing instructions. For example, a paper airplane, 10 personalized candles.
